summary: Iter-186 — Single Owner-PIN unlocks all three hidden financials (month revenue + Revenue Trend + Business by Stylist) via new /api/reports/team-unlock endpoint. Backend pytest 5/5 pass: manager GET /reports/team-unlock → 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED without pin, 403 with wrong PIN 0000 (only 1 wrong attempt consumed), 200 with X-Owner-Pin:4321 returning month_revenue (number), revenue_trend (7 entries with date+revenue), staff_performance with all 6 keys (today, yesterday, week, month, last_month, ranges). Owner GET returns 200 same shape without PIN. Frontend Playwright (manager, Bangalore geo 12.9631691,77.7132717) — every assertion PASS: initial state has all 3 testids [month-revenue-masked]=1, [revenue-trend-locked]=1, [perf-locked]=1; lock button text 'Unlock all with Owner PIN'; clicking [perf-unlock-btn] opens [owner-pin-modal] → enter 4321 → [owner-pin-ok] → ALL THREE unlocked in one shot (masked=0, trend-locked=0, perf-locked=0, modal auto-closed); [kpi-revenue-month] shows ₹15,989 with [month-revenue-hide-btn] visible; [revenue-trend-stats] renders (Total ₹11,800, Daily Avg ₹1,686, Highest ₹7,080 · 18 Sept, 3 days with billing); [perf-tab-last_month] click renders 3 rows; success toast 'Unlocked for this session — month revenue, Revenue Trend & Business by Stylist' shown. Fresh reload → clicking [revenue-trend-unlock-btn] first also opens [owner-pin-modal], correct PIN unlocks ALL THREE cards. Owner (admin@miracurl.com) sees Revenue Trend + Business by Stylist rendered directly (revenue-trend-locked=0, perf-locked=0, revenue-trend-stats=1, month-revenue-lock-btn=1). Only 1 wrong PIN consumed (0000) — well below 5-attempt lockout. tenants.hide_month_revenue left TRUE.
